name: Ohana
source:
Ohana is [url=/c87166/]Mikoto[/url]’s tutor. She’s a forest nymph who’s lived for several centuries, and she possesses immense magical power that rivals even that of Mikoto’s mother, Himiko.

Ohana is a stern woman, and she takes her duties as Mikoto’s tutor very seriously. She’s the first to rebuke Mikoto whenever she makes a mistake – but she loves her charge a great deal, and wants only the best for her.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1157640/Sakura_Fox_Adventure/]Steam[/url]]
